known_facts: The strict local D2-D4 asset audit completed before the failure.
The diagnostic reached final payload serialization, so BF16 generation and all three requested teacher-forced scoring calls returned.
No numeric_diagnostic.json was committed atomically because serialization failed before the temporary output was replaced.
The failure did not mutate any Phase-2 cache and did not compute research metrics.

repair.policy: Preserve strict RFC-compliant JSON and preserve the non-finite classification; never emit, clamp, or replace NaN with a fabricated finite score.
repair.scope: Serialization only; model, data, generation, scoring, candidate sets, and existing caches remain unchanged.
